provenance.construction: Multi-band dense packing of distance-9 surface-code patches (arXiv:2511.06758 generalized): rows=2 bands, m=8 patches per even band, band pitch 8, patch pitch Px=20. Built by research/multiband_surface.py build(d=9, rows=2, m=8, pitch=8).
provenance.notes: Generalizes the multi-band dense packing of arXiv:2511.06758 beyond its published two-band, three-patch configuration. Literature novelty is unverified: the parameters were checked for domination and duplication against this board only.
